tags.gist: Would represent reversibility as a gate on the postmarket trade, not a third axis, since severity orders reversible and irreversible harms the wrong way round.
Would define the activity axis by how a function changes the user's choice set, presents, ranks, filters, selects or executes, adding a rung for omission.
Says the three monitoring approaches each yield a rate without requiring its population to be stated; offers the commenter's own schema defect as a finding.
Says the first-order risk is a process receipt reading as human judgment, and lists four record properties that keep the two distinguishable.
Wants change notices to record their author so deployer detection counts, manufacturers to show detection capability beyond a contract clause, and fail-closed resumption.
Calls the incentive problem one of disclosure form: hash commitments to specific results let developers hand over less yet commit to more, scaled by re-testability.
Wants agentic records where an unrun checkpoint cannot read as passed, unstated actors read as unknown, and actions commit to input origins and sequence length.
Recommends declaring reversibility as a property of each function, with an irreversible action disqualifying it from the premarket-for-postmarket trade, instead of a third axis.
Recommends defining the activity axis by how the function alters the user's choice set, not by wording, with a rung for omission.
Recommends that every postmarket performance figure state its population, declaring whether all its sources are accounted for and counting those that are not.
Recommends allowing supervisory agents only when their output cannot structurally be mistaken downstream for human judgment.
Recommends treating a change notice observed by the deployer as equal evidence to one the vendor issues, and requiring detection capability beyond a contractual clause.
Recommends building the voluntary file on hash-anchored commitments to specific results, scaling expectations by whether anyone can independently re-evaluate the model.
Recommends agentic records distinguish skipped from passed checkpoints, treat undeclared actors as undeclared, and commit each action to its input origins and sequence length.
Says reversibility should be represented, but as a gate on the trade in Question 18 rather than as a third axis.
Says monitoring detects after the action, so it remedies reversible actions but not irreversible ones, which it only turns from unknown into known harm.
Says severity does not carry reversibility: the grid scrutinizes most the severe-but-reversible case monitoring could fix and least the limited-but-irreversible one it cannot.
Would have functions declare a reversibility class, reversible, partially reversible or irreversible, with irreversible ones ineligible for reduced premarket evidence whatever their severity.
Notes irreversibility already does work in the agentic element A.1, and wants it carried into the risk framework that governs every device.
Would record downstream safeguards as a detect-and-rollback ratio, time pressure as its own coarse band, and traceability by the explanation's method plus a hash commitment.
Says any axis defined over wording shifts whenever the text is edited, so it cannot give manufacturers predictability or let a reviewer reproduce a classification.
Defines the axis by effect on the choice set in five values, presents, ranks, filters, selects, executes, under which a talk-to-your-doctor statement changes nothing.
Says the continuum lacks an omission rung: a device dropping options directs by subtraction, is more directive than ranking, and looks neutral to wording measures.
Says a single ladder spanning informational and action-taking lets a drifting multi-turn device be characterized by the top rung it is built to reach.
Says none of the three approaches must state the population behind its rate, so re-benchmarking results and premarket baselines cannot be compared.
Reports as a finding that the commenter's own specification shipped four schemas carrying ratios whose denominators never traveled, a defect that survived review.
Wants each postmarket figure accompanied by its inclusion criterion, totals, exclusions with grounds, and whether its sources are wholly accounted for.
Adds an arithmetic check: included records plus declared exclusions must sum to the total considered, exposing undeclared exclusions that look fine element by element.
Says silent sampling, a program quietly ceasing to ingest a stream, escapes record-level counts, so the completeness check must sit at the source level.
Calls agent reliability second-order: the first-order risk is that volumes of supervisory records read downstream as human judgment, by default rather than deceit.
Would permit supervisory agents only if their output cannot structurally pass as human judgment, secured by four mechanical properties.
The four properties: oversight class re-derivable from the signed record, a hash of what the reviewer saw, a model-assistance flag, and absence reading as absence.
Says sample-based clinician review must record whether the reviewer had the context, authority, evidence and time to challenge an output, or judgment was not preserved.
Wants change notices to record their author, so deployer-observed changes count as first-class evidence and vendor silence shows as a pattern.
Lists what a notice should carry: vendor, model family, versions before and after, change class, effect date and a hash of vendor documentation.
Wants proven detection capability, not just a contractual clause: periodically re-benchmark against a fixed set, recording the model version at each run.
Where modifications cannot be prespecified, rejects broader prespecification: reliance on a withdrawn model version resumes only on an affirmative record, fail-closed.
Would build the file on hash commitments to specific evaluation results, not documents, citing the PIP implants, where a valid certificate vouched only for paperwork.
Would scale expectations by whether independent re-testing is possible: open-weight models need little, while access-gated models leave provider attestations as the only artifact.
Wants prespecified pass and fail bounds committed by hash at a witnessed instant, so a sponsor shifting the acceptance bar after the score is detectable.
Proposes four properties for the record an agentic run leaves behind, each catching a way the run can look compliant, without disclosing content.
Skipped checkpoints must not read as passed, unstated actors as human; each action commits to input origins against injection, and to sequence length against truncation.
